prompts.walk: Use case: identity-preserve / illustration-story. Create a production 2D ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET with EXACTLY TWELVE progressive drawings of ONE slow weary WALK CYCLE, arranged in an exact 4-column by 3-row grid. Each square cell is a consecutive frame, read row-major. Transparent alpha background. Reference images are the exact character design: small teal-hooded dungeon repair worker, brown work apron, brass goggles ABOVE the forehead, brown gloves/boots, sleepy pale human face, tiny wrench, dragging a small brown brass-trim wheeled toolbox with rear hand. Preserve the reference's hand-drawn ink, warm shading, chibi proportions and exact outfit, not a new design. Full body and the same toolbox in EVERY cell, side-three-quarter view facing screen RIGHT throughout. Character and toolbox have identical size and registration in all cells. Hip at the same spot in each cell. The toolbox wheels stay at the SAME ground baseline, and its rear hand stays on the handle. Only legs, slight arm follow-through and very subtle shoulder weight shift change. One complete low shuffling walk cycle in 12 small sequential changes: frames 1-6, near LEFT boot progresses from forward heel contact through full planted weight to rear toe-off while far RIGHT boot slides low forward; frames 7-12, far RIGHT boot takes forward contact and bears weight while near LEFT boot swings LOW back to the start. Clearly alternating legs, two feet not fused, both boots always present. In-between poses between contact, compression, passing and toe-off. Feet lift only a few pixels, NOT a high-knee march, NOT kicking. Tired forward lean and head position stay consistent, eyes half closed. Keep head size, goggles, face, torso and toolbox visually identical between cells. Minimal vertical bobbing, no bouncing, no hopping. First and last poses should lead smoothly into the next loop. Ample transparent margins, no sprite touches a cell border, no labels, no text, no panel lines, no shadows on a floor, no scenery, no breath puff or floating motion marks. Frame-to-frame continuity and correct walking anatomy are more important than pose variety. True transparent PNG background, not drawn checkerboard.
prompts.settle: Use case: identity-preserve / illustration-story. Make a transparent 2D animation sprite sheet with EXACTLY 12 progressive frames in an exact 4-column by 3-row grid, same full-body teal-hooded dungeon repair worker and wheeled toolbox as the references, facing screen RIGHT. Exact same costume, sleepy face, brass goggles above forehead, leather apron, boots, wrench and toolbox. Match the thick ink and soft warm comic shading. The sequence is the smooth end of a tired walk followed by breathing in: frames 1-6 progressively finish the LAST SMALL SHUFFLING STEP: (1) left/front boot in low forward contact and rear boot behind, (2) body weight eases onto front boot, (3) rear boot slides forward close to floor, (4) rear boot nearly beside front, (5) both boots land almost together, (6) fully stopped, both boots planted and shoulders heavy. Toolbox rolls to a stop behind him and the hand stays attached to its handle; keep its wheels on the same fixed baseline. Frames 7-12 progressively INHALE without moving feet: tiny chest rise, shoulders lift gradually, head lifts only slightly, eyelids slowly close. Last frame has eyes closed, shoulders gently raised, lips only slightly pursed ready to exhale, not a surprised or yelling face. Every adjacent frame is a SMALL change. Lock character scale, hip registration, toolbox size and ground baseline across all 12 cells. No bobbing or jumping between cells; boots and toolbox remain planted during frames 6-12. No dramatic pose change, no disappearing wrench, no extra limbs, no skin or costume change. Identical size square cells, generous transparent margins. No scene, ground, frame borders, numbers, text, cloud or breath puff. Preserve genuine transparent alpha.
prompts.sigh: Use case: identity-preserve / illustration-story. Create a transparent sprite sheet with EXACTLY 12 smooth sequential frames, strict 4 columns by 3 rows, of the SAME teal-hooded weary dungeon repair worker facing screen RIGHT from the reference. Full body plus dragged wheeled toolbox and wrench in every cell. Match precise chibi character identity, brass goggles ON hood above forehead, sleepy pale face, brown apron/gloves/boots, ink contours and warm cel shading. This is one gradual weary SIGH, with both boots and toolbox wheels FIRMLY PLANTED on the SAME baseline in ALL cells. Frame1: shoulders just raised after inhaling, eyes gently closed, mouth just starting to open. Frames2-4: lips gradually form a SMALL relaxed O, shoulders begin to lower. Frames5-8: long gentle exhale, chin and shoulders droop progressively, upper back rounds slightly, eyes remain tired/closed; no exaggerated yawning or giant mouth. Frames9-10: mouth gradually closes, shoulders finish falling. Frames11-12: exhausted settled posture, half-open sleepy eyes, head a little bowed; final frame is suitable to hold motionless. Changes must be subtle and continuous between adjacent frames, same head size, body scale, clothes and toolbox throughout. No walking, no boot movement, no floating, no knee jumping. The rear hand holds the same toolbox handle and near hand keeps the same small wrench. Keep hip and foot registration consistent; preserve the real decrease in upper-body height as he slumps. Ample transparent padding around every sprite, no cell overlaps, no text, no panel lines, no numbers, no scenery, no breath clouds (added separately in the game), no floating stress marks. True transparent background.

cleanup.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Clean ONLY the alpha background of the attached 12-frame 4x3 animation sheet. Preserve all 12 worker drawings, their poses, grid order, size, outlines, toolbox, boots and colors exactly. Remove EVERY stray gray/white/red speckle, haze, dirty fringe, border line and semi-transparent background remnant outside the actual character/toolbox silhouettes. The entire empty space between sprites and along all outer edges must be completely transparent alpha=0. Preserve real anti-aliasing only immediately on the drawn contour, not stray noise. Do NOT add a floor, shadows, background, checkerboard, text or new drawings. Do not change the animation poses or crop the sheet. Output the same 4-column 3-row transparent sprite sheet with clean empty gutters.
